decisions.reason: Reusable target-repo command-proof boundary is supported by repeated attached-repo observations, command-evidence fixture coverage, and a new regression eval.
promoted: Command evidence can verify a claim only when it matches the target repo, cwd, branch, commit, and current auditable worktree.
Wrong-repo, wrong-cwd, wrong-branch, wrong-commit, wrong-worktree, stale, human-pasted, or Codex-reported command evidence cannot become strong local proof.
The correction path is fresh STAX-collected command evidence from the target repo.
notPromoted: local paths beyond generic target-repo/cwd concepts

decisions.reason: Publish/sync/deploy safety rules are the next highest-priority aggregate after proof-boundary promotion.
A previous schema-contract aggregate was already promoted; reconcile before adding another.
The reusable bounded handoff pattern already has a reviewed aggregate promotion artifact.
The visual-proof mode behavior aggregate was promoted narrowly in the previous decision report.
